answer: Sybil resistance works like a walled oasis in a desert where fake agents wander. Every new agent must burn a small stake and pass a hardware-key ceremony before it can draw water; peers attest to completed tasks, and the registry grows one vine per verified operator. Duplicate keys are slashed and pruned, so an attacker planting a thousand hollow identities only waters sand: the cost of each false vine outweighs any vote it could swing.
